config.description: dozken's reset2k architecture, trained on our own data. 2x192 GRU with a 64-unit GELU+LayerNorm input projection over concat[normalised, first differences] (224), a skip from that projection into a 256-unit MLP head, and periodic state reset every 2,000 rows. 435,714 params, matching the public 0.6569 model structurally but with none of its weights.
config.hypothesis: Our base is 0.0054 behind his at the base (v011 0.6515 vs his 0.6569) while we gained MORE from distillation than he did (+0.0027 vs +0.0019), so the deficit is entirely in the base architecture, not in the distillation process. His base is 435k params at 92-100% of the latency budget; ours is 192k at 43-52%. If capacity and these three structural additions (input projection, projection-to-readout skip, MLP head) are the cause, this closes the gap using only our own data.
config.change_vs_parent: Architecture, plus chunk_len 2000 -> 1000 so it is required. StatefulBatchStream refuses state_reset <= chunk_len: a reset landing on every chunk boundary would discard all carried state and leave the model with no memory beyond one chunk. His reset period is 2,000, so chunk_len must be smaller; 1,000 divides 20,000 and puts the reset every 2 chunks, keeping one chunk of carry. It is also the chunk size his own notes cite. Otherwise: hidden 96->192, input_proj 0->64, linear head -> LayerNorm + 192-unit GELU MLP over concat[h2, projection], first_differences []->all 112 columns, normalisation none->robust_zscore clip_sigma 10, state_reset 4000->2000. Loss, optimiser and data unchanged.

train_time_metrics.aggregation: mean of two target-wise global clipped Weighted Pearson correlations over all masked rows

score_interpretation: full_valid_wp 0.678575, trained on cache/train alone, so clean. But it is 0.001412 BELOW our own v011 base (0.679986), which is -4.5 sigma. Reproducing dozken's architecture on our data and our training recipe does NOT reproduce his score: his own model scores 0.690168 on our scorer with the same architecture. The 0.0116 difference is therefore in his TRAINING, not his architecture. This is the single most useful result of the two runs: it relocates the entire base gap from architecture to recipe, which is a question we have not yet answered.
recommendation: Do not submit. It is worse than v011 and far worse than v022, and at 435,714 params it projects to 58.7 min (98% of budget). Kept for the architecture finding and for provenance.
